I changed `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 1491). It now only returns stock rows with quantity above 0. A warehouse's stock list therefore skips products that have been taken out completely or set to 0.

The single-product quantity lookup at line 1464 is untouched, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still answers 0. I didn't add a test for your WH-1 example, and I didn't check whether an existing test covers the stock list.

The full offline suite (`mvn -q -o test`) ran with no output, which means it passed.
